# Large Language Models in Tourism Research: Support, Substitution, or Something Else?

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Josip Mikulić  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Annals of Tourism Research  
**DOI:** [10.1016/j.annals.2025.104003](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.annals.2025.104003)  
**Publisher:** [https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0160738325001094](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0160738325001094)

**Keywords:** large language models, tourism research, AI, academic integrity, research methodology

## Abstract

Examines the role of large language models (LLMs) in tourism scholarship, analyzing whether AI serves as a support tool, substitute for human researchers, or represents an entirely new paradigm for tourism research methodology.
